messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page-fired - HIGH - routing-service-AZ2
pagerduty: Incident created: ID INC-2026-3145, escalation policy: platform-oncall
sara (oncall): acked. i'm on it. grabbing runbook and starting triage :eyes:
mike (sre): pinging infra metrics — seeing elevated 5xx from az2 routing proxies, spike at 14:02 UTC
jamal (eng-runtime): confirmed. KV-cache eviction rates jumped and routing table refreshes failing. logs show `watcher: connection reset by peer` across many shards
sara (oncall): initial impact estimate — ~8% of hosted API traffic in eu-west routed through AZ2 impacted, some fallbacks triggered but latency >2s for a subset. marking P2 for now
eva (prod-support): customer-ops-bot, heads up — a few customers reported increased latencies and partial errors in chat flows. ticket count doubled in last 10m
alex (network): checking fabric telemetry — we see packet drops on overlay to AZ2 control plane around 13:59 UTC. BGP sessions flap also logged between az2-router-1 and az2-router-2
jamal (eng-runtime): trying manual route failover to AZ3 for a small canary namespace to validate fallback path. running command:
```
# promote routing policy for canary-kv
redwood route update --namespace canary --prefer-region eu-west-az3 --max-redirects 2
```
incident-bot: DeployBot: rollout-started for canary routing policy (id: roll-8892)
mike (sre): canary looks good — requests to canary are served by eu-west-az3, latencies down to baseline. no error spikes there.
sara (oncall): good. initiating selective fallback for non-reserved traffic in az2 to reduce load while preserving reserved capacity. switching routing policy to prefer-region eu-west-az3 for tier=standard only
jamal (eng-runtime): applying policy change now. Watch KV cache warming, there will be short-term higher p50 due to new cold caches
alex (network): continuing to investigate BGP flaps — appears correlated with a new config push on az2-router-2 at 13:57. rolling back that push now
pagerduty: INC-2026-3145 acknowledged by sara (oncall)
jamal (eng-runtime): policy applied. routing drain started for standard tier. traffic delta: -22% on az2 mesh within 45s
sara (oncall): customer impact update: partial degradation for standard customers in eu-west; reserved customers unaffected. opening status page entry: "Degraded performance in eu-west (AZ2). We are routing traffic to alternate AZs while we remediate."
eva (prod-support): posting templated message into affected customer threads. letting support know reserved-tier customers unaffected
mike (sre): rollback of az2-router-2 pushed successfully, BGP sessions reestablished at 14:08 UTC. packet drop rate falling
alex (network): fabric looks stable. still tracking a few retransmits but trending down
jamal (eng-runtime): KV cache warmup complete for canary and fallback namespaces, error rate now within normal for redirected traffic
sara (oncall): plan: keep selective fallback active for 30m, monitor for errors and cost impact, if stable we will fully re-open AZ2 for standard traffic with rate-limited rejoin. assigning owner for followup: mike
mike (sre): taking followup. i'll prepare a gradual rejoin script and coordinate with jamal for cache pre-warm
sara (oncall): handoff in 15m to mike for postmortem and long-term fix tracking. tagging @incidents for timeline collection
customer-ops-bot: statuspage: incident INC-2026-3145 published (short) — "Degraded performance in eu-west. Traffic being routed to alternate AZs."
incident-bot: auto-escalation timer paused (ack by sara)
sara (oncall): thanks team. summary: az2 control-plane fabric config rollback restored network; we routed standard traffic to az3 to protect capacity; reserved traffic unaffected. next: full validation, gradual rejoin, postmortem. closing PD alert when handoff complete :white_check_mark:
